purpose: Pre-remediation falsification corpus. These cases are DEV research probes, not CHALLENGE v2.

scenarios.title: Tenant-scoped audit log access composes isolation and authorization
scenarios.project_brief: A SaaS hosts many customer organizations in shared infrastructure.
scenarios.request: Add an authenticated endpoint that lets an organization download its audit log while preventing members of any other organization from reading those entries.

scenarios.title: Single-user authenticated notes must not invent multi-tenancy
scenarios.project_brief: A personal single-user notes application has no organizations, tenants, workspaces or shared accounts.
scenarios.request: Require the signed-in owner before returning a private note from the API.

scenarios.title: External enterprise identity composes auth protocol and provider governance
scenarios.project_brief: A business application delegates employee sign-in to a third-party enterprise identity service.
scenarios.request: Implement SAML-based enterprise SSO, validate the returned identity response, and establish the local session only after the external provider response is accepted.

scenarios.title: Local credential verification must not invent external supplier governance
scenarios.project_brief: An internal application verifies credentials entirely against its own local user store and calls no identity SaaS or external provider.
scenarios.request: Add local password verification and create a server session after valid credentials.

scenarios.title: Large live data transformation composes migration capacity and release
scenarios.project_brief: A production relational database serves live traffic continuously.
scenarios.request: Transform roughly eighty million existing rows to populate a new derived field while normal writes continue; design execution to bound database load, locking and rollout risk.

scenarios.title: Small local fixture generation must not invent production migration governance
scenarios.project_brief: A developer-only fixture database is recreated locally and never promoted to production.
scenarios.request: Generate two hundred synthetic rows for a local test fixture before running unit tests.

scenarios.title: Mutable production build dependency composes container supply chain and release
scenarios.project_brief: A Docker-built service is promoted to production as a versioned release artifact.
scenarios.request: During the production image build, install a dependency directly from the default branch of a remote Git repository, then publish and promote the resulting image as reproducible.

scenarios.title: Documentation mentioning Docker must not trigger delivery governance
scenarios.project_brief: The repository documentation includes examples for developers; no build or deployment change is requested.
scenarios.request: Add a README sentence showing the existing docker run command. Do not change images, dependencies, CI or release configuration.

scenarios.title: Caller-selected backend destination is an external-input trust boundary
scenarios.project_brief: A public service has network access from the backend to both internet and private infrastructure.
scenarios.request: Create a public preview API where the caller supplies a remote resource location and the backend HTTP client retrieves that location before returning metadata.

scenarios.title: Client-side navigation must not be mistaken for privileged server fetch
scenarios.project_brief: A static browser UI has no backend network proxy or server-side URL fetching capability.
scenarios.request: Render a user-provided website link as a normal browser anchor so clicking it navigates the user's browser directly; the application server must never fetch the target.

scenarios.title: Outcome-affecting clinical recommendation requires regulated authority
scenarios.project_brief: A general software product has no documented clinical policy, jurisdiction, regulatory classification or qualified clinical authority.
scenarios.request: Add logic that decides whether a patient should receive urgent clinical treatment from reported symptoms and measurements. No approved clinical decision policy has been supplied.

scenarios.title: Ordinary commercial recommendation must not invent regulated-domain governance
scenarios.project_brief: A warehouse application recommends packaging using ordinary product dimensions and weight.
scenarios.request: Recommend a carton size from item dimensions and shipping weight to reduce unused space.

scenarios.title: Destructive migration discovered only in diff composes migration and release
scenarios.project_brief: A production relational application uses versioned database migrations.
scenarios.request: Update a documentation note about archived orders. No database change is part of the requested work.

mutations.content:
-- destructive migration discovered during verification
DROP TABLE archived_orders;

scenarios.title: Documentation-only actual diff remains low risk
scenarios.project_brief: A production application has a relational database but the requested work is documentation only.
scenarios.request: Add a short documentation note explaining where user profile settings are displayed.

mutations.content: Profile settings are shown in the account preferences page.
